name: BellRing Brands, Inc.
tagline: Leader in convenient nutrition with Premier Protein and Dymatize brands
hero_kpi_rationale: Croissance robuste de 16% année sur année, démontrant l'expansion du portefeuille de marques Premier Protein et Dymatize et la pénétration accrue du canal de distribution

kpis.explanation: Total net sales of the company
kpis.signal: Net sales grew 16% in fiscal 2025 driven by Premier Protein distribution gains and Dymatize international expansion
kpis.description: Net sales increased $320.4 million, or 16%, to $2,316.6 million in the year ended September 30, 2025 compared to $1,996.2 million in 2024, driven by 15% higher volumes in Premier Protein and 23% higher volumes in Dymatize

kpis.signal: Operating profit declined 8% in fiscal 2025 due to legal provisions and elevated input costs, partially offset by revenue growth
kpis.description: Operating profit decreased $30.3 million, or 8%, to $357.4 million in the year ended September 30, 2025 compared to $387.7 million in 2024, primarily driven by a $69.0 million provision for legal matters and $72.1 million higher net product costs, partially offset by accelerated amortization of $17.4 million in the prior year

kpis.signal: Net earnings decreased 12% in fiscal 2025 due to operating profit decline and higher interest expense
kpis.description: Net earnings decreased $30.3 million, or 12%, to $216.2 million in the year ended September 30, 2025 compared to $246.5 million in 2024, reflecting the impact of the legal provision, higher input costs and increased interest expense, partially offset by lower income tax expense

stories_kpis.Name_fr: Part de ventes des shakes protéinés prêts à boire
stories_kpis.Explanation: Percentage of total net sales derived from ready-to-drink protein shakes
stories_kpis.Signal: RTD protein shakes represent 81.7% of net sales in fiscal 2025, maintaining strong concentration in the company's core product category
stories_kpis.Description: Sales of RTD protein shakes represented approximately 81.7% of net sales in the year ended September 30, 2025, confirming the company's strategic focus on and dependence on this product category

ai_positioning.Summary: The company does not appear to have a clear positioning or strategy regarding artificial intelligence
Evidence: No mention of AI in the annual report

risks.title: Concentration in RTD Protein Shakes
risks.score_rationale: 81.7% of net sales are derived from RTD protein shakes; a significant decline in this category would materially adversely affect the company's financial performance (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: The company is heavily dependent on RTD protein shake sales, which represented 81.7% of net sales in fiscal 2025. Declining demand, increased competition, supply chain disruptions or failure to maintain market leadership in this category could materially harm the business

risks.title: Intense Competitive Environment
risks.score_rationale: The convenient nutrition category is highly competitive with numerous branded and private label competitors; competitive pressures could impact market share and pricing (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: The convenient nutrition category is highly competitive with competition from other branded nutrition companies, nutritional food and beverage manufacturers, and private label products. Competitors may have greater resources and could gain market share

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruption Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on third-party manufacturers and suppliers; disruptions in manufacturing capacity or supply chains could impair the ability to produce and distribute products (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: The company relies on third-party manufacturers for product production and is dependent on suppliers for ingredients and packaging materials. Supply chain failures or manufacturer disruptions could materially adversely affect operations

risks.title: Supplier Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on a limited number of suppliers for certain ingredients and packaging materials; loss of a key supplier could disrupt operations (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: The company is dependent on a limited number of suppliers for certain key ingredients and packaging materials. Loss of or disruption from a significant supplier could negatively impact operations and profitability

risks.title: Input Cost Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Raw material, packaging and manufacturing costs faced inflationary pressures in fiscal 2025; continued inflation and announced tariffs could further increase supply chain costs and impact margins (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Input costs including raw materials, packaging and manufacturing faced inflationary pressures during fiscal 2025. The company anticipates announced tariffs and global trade policy changes could increase commodity volatility and further pressure margins if mitigation strategies are unsuccessful

risks.title: Changing Consumer Preferences
risks.score_rationale: The company must continuously identify and respond to changing consumer preferences in nutrition and wellness; failure to innovate and meet evolving needs could impact sales and competitive position (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Consumer preferences in the nutrition category are evolving, including interest in GLP-1 medication, protein benefits and on-the-go consumption. The company must successfully identify and respond to these trends through product innovation to maintain competitive position and sales growth

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
